classification: Descriptive componentwise arithmetic differences on valid JSONL; no measured Metal absolute noise floor or boundary parity is supplied, so this is not material/derivative or full solver qualification.
header_policy: exact flattened production instruction sequence; FP32 immediates and parameter bits promoted to FP64; per-program flag bit2 selects deformation and candidate low words as in the native VM; binary64 arithmetic oracle, not a bitwise Metal branch/domain emulator; comparisons near domain or branch transitions remain unresolved without separate one-sided checks
analytical_input_policy: source_residual_before_authored_scale uses exact high-plus-low words; source_residual_with_authored_scale and accurate_component_scaled_expected each use their corresponding residual program low-word flag before applying the reported scale
